name: The Ledger Never Loses a Page

description.value: You always know, without asking, exactly how many debts any creature you can see currently owes you and the nature of each one. Once per day, treat a debtor's failed saving throw against one of your Ledger effects as a critical failure instead. Nothing is ever misfiled.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Once per day, treat a debtor's failed save vs a Ledger effect as a critical failure instead" is blocked twice over: P-DEGREE-REACTIVE (a reactive, frequency-gated fix applied after an unwanted roll is already known) and P-CROSS (the roll being fixed is a DIFFERENT creature's -- the debtor's save, not the card holder's own). The always-know-your-debts clause is purely informational and needs no rule element on its own.
